content: The DTC-specific Protect Lamp returned in the function Dem_- J1939DcmGetNextDTCwithLampStatus shall be set to Lamp On in case the cor- responding event has assigned the Indicator referenced by DemProtectLampIndi- catorRef and the UDS status bit 7 (WarningIndicator) is active (set to 1), otherwise it shall be set to Lamp Off.
